title: Koinon connector type
description: A platform-curated connector type (ADR 0007): its auth type, hosts, scopes with risk tiers (ADR 0008), the presets that map tiers to allow, ask or deny, and a machine-readable setup guide (ADR 0021). Connections (per org) and grants (per agent) refer to it by metadata.id.

apiVersion.description: Schema version of this document. Stays v1alpha1 until 1.0 (ADR 0027).

id.description: Stable identifier; also the directory name (connectors/<id>/). Templates name it in grants[].connector.

version.description: SemVer of the connector type content.

hosts.description: Every host the connector talks to. Scope network rules may only name these.

ciPaths.description: Path prefixes (relative to the repository root, with a trailing slash for a directory) whose changes run CI; the workflow guard refuses them.

ciPathsFoldCase.description: Match ciPaths without regard to case, for a provider whose file system ignores it. Default: exact.

targets.description: What a grant is narrowed to (for GitHub: repositories).

pattern.description: RE2 pattern a target must match.

presets.description: Per preset, the decision for each risk tier (ADR 0008, 0049). The forbidden tier must be deny in every preset.

permissions.description: Provider permissions by name, for example GitHub App permissions (contents: write).

auth.description: How Koinon authenticates to the provider (ADR 0006, 0007).

permissions.description: The permissions the connection's app must have, and no more.

forbiddenPermissions.description: Permissions the app must not have; the connection test fails when it does.

tokenLifetime.description: Lifetime of a minted credential, as a Go duration.

tokenWarnAfter.description: For a static token that does not expire (ADR 0063): its age, as a Go duration, after which Koinon warns that it is old. Nothing blocks on age and nothing rotates the token.

site.description: The default location of a code host and how a connection on another host maps onto it (ADR 0062). Both URLs are https and name hosts in spec.hosts.

apiURL.description: The REST API of the default host.

apiPath.description: Where the REST API is served on a connection's own host; empty when it is not served there.

selfHosted.description: The connector has no host of its own: every connection names its base URL, which may carry a sub-path (https://host[:port][/path]), and baseURL and apiURL here are placeholders on a reserved .invalid host. The rules in spec.scopes are written for the root of that host and get the sub-path as a prefix.

capabilities.description: The capability descriptor of a code host (ADR 0062, 0063).

maxRepositories.description: Repositories one credential can be narrowed to; 0 when it cannot narrow.

canDenyCI.description: Whether the credential can refuse changes to CI files.

exactModes.description: Whether the provider's API writes exact git file modes.

writes.description: How commits reach the host: through its API (the default) or by git push from koinon-api.

networkRule.description: A direct call the sandbox may make (allow-tier scopes only), compiled to OpenShell policy (plan item C2). {owner} and {repo} are filled from the grant's targets.

host.description: An exact host name. Patterns are refused: a wildcard host reopens a DNS exfiltration channel (ADR 0075).

paths.description: OpenShell REST path globs: * matches within one segment, a whole-segment ** matches one or more segments. Matching is case-sensitive.

query.description: Query parameters the request must carry, each with a glob its every value must match (OpenShell L7 query matcher).

deny.description: A deny rule: requests it matches are refused even if an allow rule matches (OpenShell deny_rules). Deny rules may not use {owner} or {repo}.

permissions.description: The provider permissions a credential minted for this scope is narrowed to.

network.description: Direct network access from the sandbox. Only scopes in the read tier may have it: anything that writes goes through tools (ADR 0042).

tools.description: MCP tools behind agentgateway that this scope grants. A grant's CEL allowlist is the union over its non-denied scopes.

url.description: An https URL. {field} placeholders are filled from fields entered so far.

type.description: integer and text are plain inputs; pem is a multi-line PEM block.

secret.description: A secure input (ADR 0021): posted once, written straight to a Kubernetes Secret, never stored in Postgres, returned by the API, logged or shown to a model.

pattern.description: RE2 pattern the value must match.

value.description: A setup-specific value the guide shows for copying into the provider's console.

body.description: Markdown shown in the UI and to the agent builder.

fields.description: Field ids entered in this step.

check.description: A built-in check (implemented in Go, referenced by name) that validates the step once its fields are entered.

setupGuide.description: One source for the connection page and the agent builder (ADR 0021).
